subject: Error Writing a Loop to Calculate Variograms for Multiple Dataframes

messages.author: 0cb1ab1dff2bfeb6
messages.subject: Error Writing a Loop to Calculate Variograms for Multiple Dataframes
parts:
Hello, I am trying to find a way to create variograms for a list of multiple tracking dataframes. My plan is to write a function that contains a for loop for calculating individual variograms within a telemetry object, then using lapply to run that function across all my  telemetry objects. I've almost gotten it to work, however a single telemetry dataframe is causing an error. I believe it has something to do with the fact that this dataframe contains only a single individual. Here is my current setup:

SVF<-function(x){
  SVF<-list()
  for(i in 1:length(x)){
    SVF[[i]] <- variogram(x[[i]])
    plot(SVF[[i]],main=names(x[i]))
  }}

I then create a list of my dataframes
Tdata<-list(Tdata2000,Tdata2001,Tdata2002,Tdata2003,Tdata2004,Tdata2005,Tdata2006,Tdata2007,Tdata2008,Tdata2009,Tdata2010,Tdata2011,Tdata2012)
names(Tdata)<-c("Tdata2000","Tdata2001","Tdata2002","Tdata2003","Tdata2004","Tdata2005","Tdata2006","Tdata2007","Tdata2008","Tdata2009","Tdata2010","Tdata2011","Tdata2012")

Finally, I use lapply to run all the dataframes through my function

lapply(Tdata,SVF)

As mentioned, this function works for all of my other telemetry objects, but it keeps crashing at the single-individual object. Is there any easy fix anyone can think of? 
I can work on a working example later, I don't have the time right now, but I thought I should post what I have in case it's an easy fix.
Thanks!

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Error Writing a Loop to Calculate Variograms for Multiple Dataframes
parts:
Hi Jason,

What class are the objects in the Tdata list? variogram() requires them to be telemetry objects.

sapply(Tdata,class)

Best,
Chris

messages.subject: Re: Error Writing a Loop to Calculate Variograms for Multiple Dataframes
parts:
Hi Jason,

You want drop=FALSE in as.telemetry(), which will always return a list of telemetry objects, even if there's only one individual in the original data.frame.

Best,
Chris
